sources.title: Sudan travel advice and advisories
sources.officialityEvidence: The current travel.gc.ca destination page is Government of Canada guidance, was last updated 20 August 2026, separately identifies the Regular Canadian passport, and gives its visitor-visa timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Allow at least 2 months between your visa application and the intended date of travel.

sources.title: Sudan Travel Advice & Safety
sources.publisher: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade, Australian Government
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Smartraveller destination advice is Australian Government passport-holder guidance and directly addresses Australians travelling to Sudan despite the current do-not-travel advisory.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If, despite our advice you travel to Sudan, you'll need a visa to enter. Getting a visa can take several months.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: advance Sudan tourist visa
policies.summary: Current Canadian Government guidance specifies a tourist visa for a Regular Canadian passport and directs a visa application at least two months before intended travel. This establishes advance, not arrival, issuance timing.
conditions: Ordinary Canadian passport and short tourist visit only; Canadian guidance separately warns that official-travel passports can have different rules.
Apply before travel: the Government of Canada directs at least two months between the visa application and intended travel and says visas are not automatic.
Sudan requires foreigner registration after arrival; that registration is not treated as the visa issuance route.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: advance Sudan visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Australian Government advice says an Australian visitor needs a Sudan visa and that obtaining it can take several months. That is an advance-visa route, not visa on arrival.
conditions: Ordinary Australian passport and short visitor only.
Obtain the visa before travel; the current issuer-side advice says a visa is needed for entry and can take several months to obtain.
The current do-not-travel advisory and border-operation risks do not change the normalized visa issuance route.
